description: Checks Shodan's passive scan records for TCP port 3389 (RDP) on an IPv4 address. Says whether RDP was seen open (not a live test, and the record can be days old). An address with no Shodan record returns seen=false with known=false; that is not proof the port is closed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_rdp_exposure_check
title: Security Rdp Exposure Check
